jobs.role: Assistant (AI Specialist) – Valuation and Analytics Advisory
jobs.elig: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field; 0–1 year of experience. Hands-on exposure to Python, AI/ML tools, or cloud machine-learning platforms is required.
jobs.desc: Deloitte USI seeks a fixed-term Assistant (AI Specialist) in Audit & Assurance Valuation and Analytics Advisory. The role supports evaluations of AI risks, governance, model reliability and controls used in enterprise and financial-reporting processes. The stated engagement is six months, with standard working hours of 11 AM–8 PM and possible night shifts during January and February.
resp: Help engagement teams identify how clients use machine learning, generative AI and agentic systems.
Support AI model reliability, performance, assumptions and governance assessments.
Assist with audit control testing and documentation of AI-related risks.
Prepare analysis, scorecards, reporting and stakeholder communications.
jobs.who: Candidates with 0–1 year of experience and a related bachelor’s degree who can demonstrate foundational AI/ML and Python or cloud ML experience should review the official requirements. This is a six-month fixed-term position.
